_readme: Line pacing (T30). BPC_LinePlayer reads it at the first line of a run. Each line on my screen holds for line_base + line_per_word x its words (action and speech), kept between line_min and line_max, before the next line plays. Before an AI line in Free Talk and the reactions, '<name> is typing...' shows for a random time between typing_min and typing_max. cue_hold: how long the queue waits after a screen change of that kind (a banner, a cut with its reveal stamp), so the next line doesn't play under it; a kind that isn't listed waits 0. fast_scale multiplies every wait when fast_lines is on in Local/switches.json, for autoplay checks. Every time is in seconds.
